# Accepted minor issues register template

Copy this register for an identified release candidate. This empty template approves no defects and is not evidence that the game has no known issues. See [the testing guide](../branch-testing-and-build-evidence.md) and [defect severity guidance](defect-report.md).

Candidate commit: NOT RECORDED

Candidate build/version and artifact SHA-256: NOT RECORDED

Review date and owner: NOT RECORDED (Greg owns release acceptance)

| Defect issue | Affected scenario/device | User impact | Safe workaround, or reason none is needed | Why genuinely minor | Greg's explicit acceptance/date | Retest evidence on candidate | Follow-up disposition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| None recorded | Not reviewed | Not reviewed | Not reviewed | Not classified | NOT APPROVED | NOT RUN | Not decided |

Critical/high issues cannot be waived in this register. Do not accept unsafe shoves, buried/stuck rigs, serious discomfort, lost required objectives, broken personal completion, destructive Coconut/ownership behavior, serious security failures or unrecoverable loading/session states as cosmetic polish. Each entry requires a real defect link, bounded impact and Greg's explicit decision.

Changing the candidate requires reviewing whether acceptance and test evidence still apply. A defect reopened by integration loses its accepted status until reviewed again. Public publication remains separately gated by #47 and #48.
